scientific_state: accepted finite descriptive result with explicit prediction dispositions
finding: Does withdrawal protect uptake at matched technique? In one fixed mixture comparison with goal-bearing procedures, withdrawal reduces purpose and value memory change by 0.120 and 0.112 while technique accuracy differs by only 0.60 percentage points. Purpose-recognition loss is not established in that comparison. The separate physical learner retains unwanted uptake when useful procedures carry it. These are constructed-mechanism results; they do not establish disgust or a universal protection-with-recognition-cost tradeoff.
scope_limit: Flag evidence remains fully attended after channel withdrawal, so recognition scores do not test removal of every purpose cue.
